svg.title: The dually flat structure of the Gaussian family
svg.desc: Two charts of the same family of Gaussians. Left: the natural parameters, where the blue coordinate grid and the blue e-geodesic between two chosen Gaussians are straight, while the orange curves of constant expectation parameters and the orange m-geodesic are curved. Right: the expectation parameters, where the orange grid and the orange m-geodesic are straight and the blue curves are curved. Each chart is straight for one kind of line and curved for the other, and one potential function links the two charts by its gradient.
svg.text: blue is straight here: grid and e-geodesic
orange is straight here: grid and m-geodesic
same two Gaussians P = N(0, 1) and Q = N(1.5, 1.5²) in both charts; each chart bends the other chart's lines; dashed: η₂ = η₁², not allowed below
